n.app.tabs.index.practice-nudge-sub.en: Rehearse reporting a result on a practice polling unit before polling day. Nothing you enter counts as a real result.
n.app.tabs.index.practice-nudge-sub.ha: Gwada aika sakamako a rukunin zaɓe na atisaye kafin Ranar zaɓe. Babu abin da ka shigar da zai zama sakamako na gaske.
n.app.tabs.index.practice-nudge-sub.ig: Mee omume ịkọ nsonaazụ na ngalaba ntuli aka omume tupu Ụbọchị ntuli aka. Ọ dịghị ihe ị tinyere ga-agụ dị ka ezigbo nsonaazụ.
n.app.tabs.index.practice-nudge-sub.yo: Ṣe àdánwò jíjábọ̀ àbájáde ní ẹ̀ka ìdìbò àdánwò kí Ọjọ́ ìdìbò tó dé. Kò sí ohun tí o bá tẹ̀ sí i tí yóò kà gẹ́gẹ́ bí àbájáde gidi.
